title: Resolved D/ST week corpus
description: The resolved per-week D/ST fantasy score for every team-week in the corpus seasons, written by scripts/build_kdst_history.py and read OFFLINE by scripts/backtest_kdst.py so the R55 never-regress gate can run in CI without the network. Regular season only: a playoff week is not part of a fantasy season and would bias the surrendered-points table toward the teams that reach January. Scored by scripts.build_kdst.dst_game_points, the same function the split itself uses, so the corpus and the model cannot disagree about what a D/ST point is. MARKET POLICY: nfldata games.csv is read for game_id / teams / SCORES ONLY.

skipped.description: Dropped games, capped at 50 for size. A game without a score row is dropped WHOLE — points allowed decides a tier, so half a game is not a row.

week.description: Regular season only — 18 is the ceiling by contract.

pts.description: D/ST fantasy points this defense actually scored that week.
